steps.name: Mors tua, vita mea (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Ve▒ed] in 「▒bo▒」, then find [Sha▒nik] in 「Tar▒ar▒s」. After defeating [Mal▒as] in 「Na▒'s ▒」, turn in the quest to [▒ai▒].

lines.text: (Red earth fills your view, along with Veled running after a tent blowing away in the distance.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Veled...? Oh, this is Phobos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'm sure I was meeting someone in Esnil...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I remember what happened in Orcarium. Ell-Larsa vanished, and Harmonia and Geis took Iris away...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Then I returned to Esnil with Narsha. Why am I here?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No way... Surely not. It can't be.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I should go see Veled...
(Looking exhausted, Veled lies collapsed in the tent's entrance with only his face sticking out.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Sigh. It blew away again.
(When his eyes meet %s's, Veled startles and retreats.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Wh-What? You scared me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh... Yes...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: If you've come to hear about beauty, you're welcome.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh... That's not why I'm here.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Come to think of it, you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: You don't seem to be the you I know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: It's hard to explain. You have one soul, but it feels like there's another one too. Oh, even I don't know what I'm saying.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'm not sure, but... A me from another time and space? Is that it?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But Veled, shouldn't you be inside the village?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: It's nice there, but I like it here too. I need to watch over the beautiful castle. Though the wind keeps blowing my tent away...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Come to think of it, I haven't asked why you're here. What's going on?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know. I suddenly came to my senses here...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Can you tell me what happened?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You explain that you remember what happened in Orcarium and meeting someone in Esnil, but nothing beyond that.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: So that happened to the goddess. Still, the spirits took her away, so I think she'll be all right...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: You're directly connected to the goddess, so you must have been affected somehow.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you think so...?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Oh, perhaps...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I'll help you. But you'll have to find an object...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What object?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Probably the one that caused this situation.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So this isn't because Iris was injured?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Bring me the object, and I'll explain. And don't go to Esnil until you return to me. We don't know what might happen...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Would it be very dangerous?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: It just makes me a little uneasy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Where should I look?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Somewhere with strong traces of demonic power. I was thinking of the Abyss Chamber and Rosengarten... Could you try the Abyss Chamber first?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Don't worry about Rosengarten. I'll prepare to open its reverse side. If you find the object in the Abyss Chamber, I can simply close it again.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: With power similar to Asmodea's, I might be able to recreate it. Though not for very long.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Will you be all right? It could be dangerous.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I'll be fine.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Before you enter the Abyss Chamber, visit its owner. You'll need permission.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shynic? Has something happened to the Abyss Chamber...?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Valdrick went in because he wanted to hunt the devils gathering there. Apparently he had fun for the first time in a while.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: The ruler of Tartarus ran all the way here...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Shouting, 'That stupid bear wrecked the whole Abyss Chamber!! Everything's enough of a bother already! Why make me do all these annoying repairs?!' Then she left.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I know she isn't an ordinary person, so she was really frightening...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Someone who hates troublesome work must be doing a lot of it now...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is bad...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Why?
(Veled looks utterly uncomprehending.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go for now. Sigh... There must be some way once I get there.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: All right. Please do.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: What a bother.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Nothing fun, just piles of annoying work. ♡
(An unknown darkness gathers around the smiling Shynic.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Just as I expected...

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Adventurer, you've arrived?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Melvic.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The ground seems to be shaking...

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: You can think of it as Shynic's mood while she repairs the Abyss Chamber.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I've spotted an entertaining face!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Shynic.
(The moment Shynic recognizes the adventurer, the shaking throughout Tartarus stops.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: What brings you here? Something fun? Hm?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I need to enter the Abyss Chamber. As for why...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You briefly explain what happened in Orcarium and how you suddenly arrived in Phobos.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Is this Perse's dream?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Perse? A dream?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Oh, no, that doesn't seem right... If it were Perse's dream, there's no way I wouldn't recognize it...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: If that's the case... Sigh...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Fine. Go in. ♡

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: %s, Shynic says you may go to the abyss! I mean, the Abyss Chamber!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha, all right. Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Huh? Shynic's expression seems to have changed a little...)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: But come back to me afterward. Understood?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will, Shynic.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: What are you doing? Aren't you going? Go right now. If you don't, you might die. ♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? Oh, right. I'll go now.
(When Melvic returns after seeing the adventurer off, Shynic is sprawled on the floor.)

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Shynic, you've died of inconvenience already.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You didn't tell %s anything, did you?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Of course not.
(Shynic gets up, her eyes gleaming.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I recreated Malphas and put him inside. How convenient that I can test him now.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: You're amazing as always, Shynic!

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Hehe, won't it be fun?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Though I don't know what %s will think.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Was it fun? It was fun, wasn't it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha... It was fun.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: If you made it through all right...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Then I suppose I can raise the Abyss Chamber's difficulty further. Someday I'll throw you into a proper abyssal pit. ♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Just hearing that is frightening...)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: But did you find what you were looking for?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, nothing.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: If something had appeared, I would have found it first. All I found was a box of bones from the meat Valdrick ate.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I ran to Phobos and asked him. He said he'd forgotten to bring the box of bones out.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: That sounds like Valdrick.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I thought dealing with that stupid bear would only be more trouble, so I left it.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: If you didn't find it here, you'll have to search more places where demons have been. Rosengarten...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'd like to go with you, but it seems the person involved has to find this object.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It can't be helped. Thank you for offering, anyway.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Sniff, sniff.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It smells like a witch, but it isn't a witch.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then what is it?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I don't know either.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Even after living this long, I can't know everything in the world.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's a shame I can't help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. I'll go see Veled, then. Goodbye.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It was nice to see you after so long. Come play again.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Until next time, %s.

steps.name: Mors tua, vita mea (3)
steps.objective: Defeat [▒smo▒▒] in 「Rose▒gar▒en」 and obtain the <Black Moon Pendant>. Then turn in the quest to [▒le▒].

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: How was the Abyss Chamber?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: When I said I'd made it through safely, Shynic said she would make it harder.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: She's as wicked as any devil. So you didn't bring anything?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I couldn't find anything.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Then Rosengarten is next. While you were at the Abyss Chamber, I created Rosengarten's reverse side.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right after creating it?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Yes. I rested a little, and I'm fine. This much is...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll go right away.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: It's nothing much, but something bothers me. If you wander the reverse side searching for traces of the Demon Realm...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Beings that have remained hidden may react. Demons, witches...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then perhaps the reason I came here and met you...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: It's different from a witch playing tricks. It almost seems to be asking you to find it.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I wanted to understand that, so I asked you to find the object, %s. If it belongs to a demon, I'll recognize it.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I'd like to come along, but things might get strange if I enter. I'll rest here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll be back.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Be careful...
(After wandering Rosengarten's reverse side for some time, you find a black object on the ground.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's this? A pendant?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A black crescent moon... It doesn't suit this red rose garden.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It feels as though someone deliberately left it for me to take...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh. Then I suppose I have to take it.
(Veled receives the Black Moon Pendant from %s and examines it closely.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: It seems broken, but it's still holding its shape...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can you tell anything?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: As you said, it seems to have been placed there for you to take. To return where you belong, you must destroy it without a trace.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I hope that will be the end of it...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Try it first.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's see...
(The Black Moon Pendant looks ready to crumble, but %s's strength cannot break it.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Let me try. Most weak beings suffer mental collapse at my hands...
(Veled reaches toward a captured lesser devil. It curses him as it vanishes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...He said his power is the same as Asmodea's. Is this much easy for him...?)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Now, let's see...
(Veled reaches toward the Black Moon Pendant, but it does not break.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: It doesn't react to my devil's power or to yours as a follower of a god.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then that means...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: It is another kind of power, but not an ordinary one. For example...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: A god with power greater than the goddess's...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Power that can effortlessly disregard time and space...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: When I said you seemed like someone else, perhaps it was because this had fallen here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But how were you able to recognize me like this?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I'm different from ordinary beings. Asmodea's power met the magic stone Vice made, and a witch's touch awakened me...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: ...We have to destroy it.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Otherwise, you'll remain between different times and spaces. You may never meet the goddess again...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: If you return to Esnil, where you were meeting someone, without destroying it...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Whatever the owner of this Black Moon Pendant wants will happen.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I think this knowledge comes from Asmodea. I knew she was wise, having lived so long with the succubi in the Demon Realm...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Even if we resolve this, there's no guarantee the being behind it won't do the same thing again...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Still, we should get you out of this situation first.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: But something is strange. The pendant's owner's power affects only you. Shouldn't the ruler of Tartarus and I actually be unable to recognize you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that so...? I don't know. Hmm...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: If we could learn something connected to time and space, there might be a way...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, time and space... Maybe...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Have you thought of a good approach?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's a place with many spirits that influence time, space, and emotion.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Then go there. There must be a way. Here, take this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Veled. I'll find a way and come back.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: If you find a way, neither you nor I will remember this situation anyway. Like something laid over us has disappeared.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Next time, you'll listen to me talk about beauty. Understood?
(Veled watches %s wave and leave.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: What? Gone already.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Is beauty unimportant to ordinary humans?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: ...But what are you?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I forgot to close Rosengarten's reverse side, and you came out through it...
Who?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: You. You can't be here for a serious discussion of beauty.
Dolls are pretty. Beautiful.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Who are you?
Hello. ☆ I'm Circe.

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: My sister asked me to come see the doll.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: A witch...

steps.name: Mors tua, vita mea (5)
steps.objective: Defeat [Kai▒▒] in 「Time of ▒▒ros」 and obtain the <Broken Spirit Wing>. Then turn in the quest to [▒rche] in 「Pn▒ma」.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Arche.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I was thinking about something and didn't notice you arrive. Welcome, adventurer.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arche?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: You've come here while under the influence of another time and space. It won't greatly affect Pneuma's spirits, but just in case...
(Arche sprays you with the silvervine perfume she used before.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: This should make it safe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry, Arche. The reason I came like this...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Something must have happened to you, %s. It's all right. You need my help, correct?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a long story, but I'll tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell Arche everything, from what happened in Orcarium to how you came to Pneuma.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: So that is how the spirit called Ell-Larsa reached the end of his life. I never met him, but...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: At one point, the spirits in Pneuma all looked in one direction. A small light passed through Pneuma then.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Perhaps it was Ell-Larsa's light.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Lady Iris saved you, %s, because she wanted to make a choice she would not regret. So please don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, are Pneuma's spirits all right?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: They seem to be. I am not a spirit, so I can't fully understand their thoughts and feelings. Still, they must all have felt lonely...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Let's leave that for now. Go see Kairos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Kairos?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I think someone interfered with a special moment in your time, which is connected to Lady Iris, and Kairos is sensing something troubling.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it a being you know too, Arche?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I don't know. The only gods I know are Lady Gaia and Lady Iris, who are connected to Pneuma...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Kairos and Chronos have lived longer than I have and must know more, but as spirits, they cannot defy providence.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Providence...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Think of Lady Iris and Ell-Larsa, whom you saw in Orcarium.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The more I hear, the more complicated it gets. Did that old man send someone else into this world?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arche, I'll go see Kairos.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: All right. Take care, %s.
(Kairos's fur stands on end in surprise, but settles again after recognizing %s.)

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: You startled me. I'd only just fallen asleep when you appeared...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did I wake you?

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: It's all right. What brings you... Sniff, sniff... I smell perfume. You've been to Arche.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: And you've been affected by another power...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What happened was...

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: It's all right. You don't have to explain.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: The goddess is all right now, so you don't need to worry too much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And...

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: I can't tell you about that. Sorry. I'm a spirit...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, all right.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Take this to Arche.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: It's a spirit's wing that flew here from Orca's land. It's badly broken.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why is it here?

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: When that power interfered with what happened in Orca's land, this couldn't withstand it and flew into my domain.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: It remembers part of your time. Perhaps it can guide you back to the time where you belong.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But is Pneuma really all right?

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: It's fine. It's only affected a little. This place won't collapse. If it did, every world would be in danger, so even the Twisted One leaves it alone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Oh, now I can finally sleep. No one but you could take that object out of here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I see. Thank you, Kairos.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Then travel safely.
(No sooner has Kairos finished speaking than he lies down to sleep.)

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: ZzzZzz….

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Asleep already?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Somehow, I'm sleepy too. Yawn... This isn't the time. Let's hurry.

steps.name: Mors tua, vita mea (6)
steps.objective: Obtain an <Enteleche Fragment> in 「▒ntele▒he of ▒ife」 and the <Source of Light> in 「Sp▒rit's St▒m▒」. Then turn in the quest to [▒▒che] in 「▒neu▒」.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Did you have a good talk with Kairos?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. He gave me this and is sleeping comfortably now. Arche, do you know what it is?
(Arche receives the spirit's wing from %s.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: This is a spirit's wing. It seems to have fallen from a spirit that lost the light of life.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Kairos said it came to Pneuma remembering part of my time. He told me to give it to you.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: To me? Hmm...
(Arche holds the spirit's wing with an expression of complete uncertainty.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (From her face, it doesn't seem to be a secret... Huh?)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: The pendant is cracking.
(A faint cracking sound comes from the Black Moon Pendant in %s's hand. But it only cracks slightly and does not break completely.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The spirit's wing seems to have done this to the pendant... Why did it stop?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Because the black moon's power is stronger than the power spreading from the spirit's wing.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It was thanks to Lady Iris that the pendant could crack even this much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Lady Iris sent this spirit's wing. To protect you...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: As long as Lady Iris, who became mistress of the moon, flowers, and plants, remains on this star, a bright and beautiful moon will always rise...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: But otherwise, it will become a bleak black moon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait. Iris is the only mistress of the moon. Are you saying there is another being like that?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Just as Lady Gaia shared the plants, part of her earth, with Lady Seres, perhaps the moon never belonged to Lady Seres alone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know the affairs of the ancient gods, but if that's true... Oh, this is complicated...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Honestly, it's complicated for me too. I'm barely managing to organize what the spirits tell me...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: When that being reveals itself, its name will become known. But not yet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Even with Iris's help, we could only half destroy it. What do we do about the rest...? We'd need equally powerful energy...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This spirit's wing came from Orcarium. Should I search there again?
(At %s's suggestion, Arche spreads her arms. Spirits approach from somewhere and whisper to her in incomprehensible sounds.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: The spirits say that's a good idea.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Since you are in another time and space after visiting Orcarium... Orcarium must still exist in some form.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There might be an object waiting for me to come, like the Black Moon Pendant...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: If you find it, come back here. Pneuma is safer than anywhere else.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Arche. I won't go anywhere else. I'll come straight to Pneuma. See you later.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Be careful...
(While wandering the Enteleche of Life, you find a small stone fragment glowing with a peculiar light.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Enteleche fragment Narsha found...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It definitely disappeared back then...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll take it for now.
(Behind the place where you met Ell-Larsa stand trees the spirit once loved. Among the stumps, whose rings hold long years, you see a small orb of light.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is the light that circled Ell-Larsa... I can feel its powerful energy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This should do, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's take it to Pneuma...

steps.name: Mors tua, vita mea (7)
steps.objective: When everything is over, return to the final location of the 「Orcarium」 main scenario and turn in the quest to [Nar▒].

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: %s, you're back?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: When I went there, as you suggested, I found objects with powerful energy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But it felt different from when I went with Narsha.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Because it is another time and space... Perhaps even a reverse side.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Please don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Arche.
(The Black Moon Pendant, the Source of Light, and the Enteleche Fragment gather in Arche's hands. The latter two turn into brilliant light and begin wrapping around the pendant.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I can feel the pure power of spirits. The light of Ell-Larsa and the others who dwelled in Orcarium...
(The light grows and enters the cracks in the Black Moon Pendant. Soon, the pendant trembles and gradually crumbles into powder.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it all over?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Not yet. This powder cannot remain here.
(Arche reaches toward the sky, and the powder, now like glittering sand, rides the wind away.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Now you can return to your original timeline.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, but how do I get back?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Close your eyes, and the spirits will guide you to your original time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Arche. I won't fall out of the sky or anything, right?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Hehe, no.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: You will now return to your original time and space. The memories formed under the black moon's influence will disappear.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Normally, the people you met should not remember either, but beings like Veled and Shynic...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's leave them out. They aren't ordinary beings.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Hehe, all right.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: When you face your original memories, you may feel dizzy for a moment... I did too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that what happened to you then?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Yes, something similar. I'm telling you just in case.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Now, close your eyes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you later, Arche.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (All right, then...)
(Warm cotton? Clouds? Was it an Aerura? It's so soft I could fall asleep like this...)
(You raise your head to see a woman with blue eyes shining like jewels and a kindly smile.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What is this drowsy feeling...? Did I go somewhere for a while...?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (But who is she? She's so beautiful it's as though a halo shines around her... She's wearing a sun-shaped tiara...)

lines.speaker: 여성
lines.text: Hello, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello... Do you know me?

lines.speaker: 여성
lines.text: Of course.
(The woman suddenly takes both of %s's hands.)

lines.speaker: 여성
lines.text: I've wanted to meet you, but never had the chance. Both you and I have been busy, %s.

lines.speaker: 여성
lines.text: Let me introduce myself.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Honestly, what is my silly sister doing...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I am Kaina Dawn Silvaria... Dayna's older sister. Thank you for helping my younger sisters so much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a pleasure to meet you too. But if you're Dayna's older sister...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? Huh? What?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Her Majesty, Empress of the Silvaria Empire?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Wait... This feels familiar. Have I met Her Majesty before? No, I haven't...)
(For an instant, a different expression flashes across Kaina's smiling face.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Your Majesty?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, nothing...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: If you stand there so dazed, you might fall into the Sea of Emptiness. Hehe.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: There is something I'd like to tell you.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: About the new witch who will soon appear...
